sentences.text: There's something heavy about the way this jester sits through the party in silence.
This is Stańczyk, painted by Jan Matejko in 1862.
A jester sits alone in a dark room while a royal ball goes on.
According to its full title, Stańczyk sat at a ball facing the loss of Smolensk.
A jester should be making the court laugh.
But Smolensk had just been lost to Moscow.
The whole court is celebrating, yet only the fool understands the news.
Almost as if the wisest man there wears the bells.
Maybe that is why Matejko gave him his own face.
So what would you do if only you had read it?

Stańczyk is shown sitting alone in a dark room, while a ball, hosted by the royal family, is in full swing in the neighbouring hall.
